ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known FP-SUB08. Intentional design, limitAmount caps expenditure. Guardian rejected.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Executor context spoofing to settle with wrong recipient
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: msg.sender == AMM enforced in both PermitTransferHandler and CLOBTransferHandler. AMM sets executor = msg.sender.
Globally incrementing nonces (nextOrderNonce++). Order close checks msg.sender == order.maker.
Known FP-H07. Hook fees set by token owner — self-inflicted config.
Known CP-002. PermitC uses domain separator with chainId. destroyCosigner universal domain is intentional.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: ERC-1271 cosigner bypass with always-true contract
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Cosigner address signed in additionalDataHash. Attacker can't substitute. Self-inflicted only.
Known FP-P02. AMM balance check at L2208 enforces exact token transfer. Confidence 85+.
No tx.origin usage in any target contract. All auth uses msg.sender.
Both handlers check msg.sender == AMM (immutable). AMMStandardHook checks _requireCallerIsAMM(). No delegation chain to spoof.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reuse permit signature with different from address
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: PermitC binds signature to the from address.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust-loop extraction via partial fill rounding
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: mulDiv rounds DOWN (conservative). AMM balance check enforces exact accounting.
_requireCallerIsAMM() on all hook entry points. AMM address is immutable.
Known HOOK-001 (Low). Not cleared after use but constrained by reentrancy guards and same-pool-same-tx requirement.
Covered by FP-SUB08, FP-P02, and PermitC from-binding respectively.
Handlers are separate contracts, not delegatecall facets. No shared storage surface.
